I am a 4th year PhD student in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at York University. My research interests are in active vision and 3D understanding.

### Latest News
[Sep 2026] 🎉 Our paper on pictorial depth cue understanding is accepted to ECCV 2026! Check out the [Project page](https://github.com/lyiqian/o3-d), [Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/liuyiqian/O3-D), or [Paper (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.01503)
